responsibility: Implements the standalone lto-wrapper driver program invoked by collect2 or the linker plugin to orchestrate whole-program LTO. It parses and merges saved GCC options from the environment, determines whether to run normal LTO or WHOPR, drives the compiler’s WPA phase, reads the generated list of LTRANS jobs, chooses serial or parallel execution (including make/jobserver support), manages temporary input/output/debug files, and prints the final produced object files to stdout for the surrounding linker workflow. This file is driver and process-control logic, not IL serialization logic.
